answer: A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The trellis counter is kept in violet and saffron makes public each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 259 identities multiplies that fee by 668 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
